i.norm:
Verifies that {@link DayOfYear#from(java.time.temporal.TemporalAccessor)} returns a value equal to the one already held by the source {@code DayOfYear}.

Under the EvoSuite mocked clock the current date resolves to the 45th day of the year, so {@code DayOfYear.now()} yields day 45 and {@code from} must echo it.
